reference_sql:
WITH days AS (
  -- one row per day, 3 to 9 March 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) AS day
  FROM range(DATE '2025-03-03', DATE '2025-03-10', INTERVAL 1 DAY)
), daily AS (
  -- one row per day with nonbrand search spend
  SELECT a.spend_date AS day, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
  WHERE ch.channel_name = 'nonbrand_search'
    AND a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-03-09'
  GROUP BY a.spend_date
)
SELECT d.day, COALESCE(s.spend_eur, 0) AS spend_eur
FROM days d
LEFT JOIN daily s ON s.day = d.day

solver.query:
WITH days AS (
  SELECT CAST(d AS DATE) AS day FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-03-03', DATE '2025-03-09', INTERVAL 1 DAY) t(d)
), s AS (
  SELECT a.spend_date AS day, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns cp ON cp.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = cp.channel_id
  WHERE ch.channel_name = 'nonbrand_search'
    AND a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-03-09'
  GROUP BY a.spend_date
)
SELECT d.day, COALESCE(s.spend_eur, 0) AS spend_eur
FROM days d LEFT JOIN s ON s.day = d.day
